issuer: the Colorado Department of Revenue, Division of Motor Vehicles
note: The Colorado Revised Statutes 2024, Title 42 (the General Assembly's printout, read 2026-10-30): § 42-2-104 licenses a person 21 or older as a driver and anyone 16 to 20 as a minor driver, so the driver's licence the form holds is held from 21 (a minor driver's licence, at the same fee, from 16, expiring twenty days after the 21st birthday); § 42-2-114 has a driver's licence expire on the birthday in the fifth year after issue and the department set its fee; § 42-2-304 has an identification card expire on the birthday in the fifth year after issue. The Code of Colorado Regulations, 1 CCR 204-30, Rule 17 (version effective 30 June 2026, from the Secretary of State's register) sets the driver's or minor driver's licence fee at $34.00 and the identification card's at $14.00. The DMV's own pages refused the request behind a Cloudflare check.

sources.title: Colorado Revised Statutes 2024, Title 42 (Vehicles and Traffic)
sources.said: (a) Any person twenty-one years of age or older, as a driver; ... (c) Any person sixteen years of age or older who has not reached his or her twenty-first birthday, as a minor driver. ... the license expires on the applicant's birthday in the fifth year after issuance of the license. ... an identification card issued pursuant to this part 3 expires on the birthday of the registrant in the fifth year after issuance of the identification card.

sources.title: Code of Colorado Regulations, 1 CCR 204-30, Rule 17 (Fees), effective 30 June 2026
sources.said: The fee for a driver's license or minor driver's license under section 42-2-114 (2) (a) or (4) (a), C.R.S., respectively, is thirty four dollars and zero cents ($34.00). ... The fee for issuing or renewing an identification card under section 42-2-306 (1) (a), C.R.S. is fourteen dollars and zero cents ($14.00).
